description: Add or update a work experience entry (upsert). Omit id to create a new entry (title and startDate are required); pass an id (from get_profile) to update an existing one, changing only the fields you send. Every description should cover WHAT was built, HOW (technologies), IMPACT (users served, performance gains, revenue, uptime), and SCOPE (team size, scale). Push for measurable outcomes ("Built React frontend" -> "...serving 50K users, 40% faster"). The technologies array feeds job matching. Saving without an id always creates a new entry. Saved entries appear on the user's public profile, so they should describe real experience. Ask the user to confirm vague dates or fill real gaps.

endDate.description: End date: a date, e.g. "2024-01-15". Omit it for a current role

id.description: Present: update this work-experience entry (only the fields you pass change). Omit: create a new one (title and startDate are required to create).

isCurrent.description: Whether this is your current job (default false on create)

isRemote.description: Whether this job is remote (default false on create)

technologies.description: Technologies used (e.g. ["React", "Node.js"]). They feed job matching

name: save_work_experience
title: Save Work Experience
